    ProblemDetail:

        title:
          title: Title

          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException

        status:

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          title: Timestamp

The two new `Cp11Tests` (stores digits-only; normalized duplicate rejected with 409) pass, and the entire suite of 271 tests stays green — including the existing owner controller tests where non-punctuation garbage (letters) is still rejected as before.
